sources.name: TruckersFM
sources.description: Live radio for the road, with presenters and a broad pop playlist.

sources.name: Dark academia piano (Relaxing Piano)
sources.description: Neoclassical piano for reading, with artists such as Ólafur Arnalds, Nils Frahm and Ludovico Einaudi. A quiet-library mood.

sources.name: Dark academia piano and strings on YouTube Music
sources.description: Explore darker piano, cello and classical study mixes in YouTube Music.

sources.name: SomaFM Groove Salad
sources.description: Official permanent playlist link; downtempo and chillout electronica.

sources.name: SomaFM Drone Zone
sources.description: Official permanent playlist link; atmospheric space music with minimal beats.

sources.name: SomaFM DEF CON Radio
sources.description: SomaFM's year-round DEF CON channel: hacker culture, ambient, and electronic music.

sources.name: SomaFM Secret Agent
sources.description: Cinematic downtempo, lounge, and easy-tempo international pop; a retro spy-film mood, not game soundtrack audio.

sources.name: laut.fm Electro Swing
sources.description: User-curated Electro Swing station. The official stable station route redirects to the current audio stream.

sources.name: laut.fm Nightcore
sources.description: Nightcore station on laut.fm. For curated searches and mixes, see YouTube Music discovery below.

sources.name: Radio Dismuke
sources.description: Official playlist for vintage 1925–1935 popular music and jazz. Its audio streams use HTTP. Vintage-era listening only; not game audio.

sources.name: Explore radio around the world
sources.description: Interactive globe for discovering live local stations around the world; playback runs in the browser.

sources.name: Discover Finnish radio stations
sources.description: Search playable stations in Finland, then listen or save a favorite.

sources.name: New Finnish music on YouTube Music
sources.description: Explore Finnish releases, artists and playlists in your usual music service.

sources.name: Yle Areena radio
sources.description: Official Yle radio listings and live listening. Streams are resolved by Yle Areena and may depend on current rights or sign-in state.

sources.name: YleX
sources.description: Finnish-language music and culture radio. Play the live Yle stream or open its Areena page.

sources.name: Yle Klassinen
sources.description: Yle's digital classical channel. Play the live Yle stream or open its official page.

sources.name: YouTube Music
sources.description: Open your existing YouTube Music account and library in the browser.

sources.name: Discover Nightcore on YouTube Music
sources.description: Search YouTube Music for Nightcore playlists, artists, and mixes; no scraping or downloading.

sources.name: Discover Electro Swing on YouTube Music
sources.description: Search YouTube Music for Electro Swing artists, mixes, and playlists.

sources.name: Vintage swing and atompunk mood on YouTube Music
sources.description: Search for vintage swing and jazz inspiration. This is era-style music discovery, not licensed Fallout or game soundtrack audio.

sources.name: Twitch
sources.description: Open Twitch in the browser for live channels and followed streams.

sources.name: Jellyfin Music (Feishin)
sources.description: Browse your Jellyfin music library in a dedicated desktop player. A configured server is prefilled; sign in in the app.

sources.name: Jellyfin Desktop
sources.description: Launch the installed Jellyfin Desktop client. Sign-in and library access stay in that client.

sources.name: Radio Rivendell
sources.description: Fantasy music radio for the valley: instrumental worldbuilding and soundtracks, sometimes dramatic. Official direct stream.

sources.name: Gentle fantasy for Wizarding Valley on YouTube Music
sources.description: Find a gentler valley soundtrack: celesta, harp, felt piano and chamber strings. Choose a mix in your existing player.
